friendly_name: Felix-Vikunja Sync — Project Layer and URL Config
source_description: Implements GitHub issue #520 (Mission C of Epic #507, Felix-Vikunja bi-directional sync foundation). Replaces #518's incremental updated_since polling with full-poll + 3-way set diff for the task and project layers, eliminating the documented 15-min deletion gap from RQ-4 (deletion converges in N=1 cycle = 5min). Adds project-layer cache + diff events to the reconciliation driver (audit/discovery only; no downstream consumer changes). Normalizes the two concurrent Vikunja URL bases (https Tailscale + http direct IP) into a single canonical config file (/data/services/openclaw/config/vikunja-base-url.txt) with an env var convenience wrapper (VIKUNJA_BASE_URL). FR-3 scope is narrow: the 6 migrated touchpoints from #519 + the #518 driver + the 2 retained write touchpoints (TP-04 PUT + TP-12 _http_get for comments). One-off setup/utility scripts will be tracked in a separate follow-up issue. Discovery decision 2026-06-05: Kent challenged the incremental-poll model as overly complex for the ~50-task scale; research mission RQ-4 § 4 confirmed full-poll was a considered option ("acceptable at Felix's scale") and the 15-min deletion gap was the only NFR-002 miss in the original design. Final mission in the Epic #507 implementation arc.
